stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import numpy as np
A=np.array(L); B=np.array(R)
res=[]
for dy in range(-12,13):
 for dx in range(-10,11):
  # B origin relative A = (dy,dx)
  ar0=max(0,dy); ar1=min(A.shape[0],dy+B.shape[0]); ac0=max(0,dx); ac1=min(A.shape[1],dx+B.shape[1])
  if ar0>=ar1 or ac0>=ac1: continue
  aa=A[ar0:ar1,ac0:ac1]; bb=B[ar0-dy:ar1-dy,ac0-dx:ac1-dx]
  n=np.count_nonzero((aa!=0)|(bb!=0)); eq=np.count_nonzero((aa==bb)&((aa!=0)|(bb!=0)))
  res.append((eq/n,n,eq,dy,dx, np.count_nonzero(aa!=bb)))
sorted(res,reverse=True)[:15]
